chosen_args.why_stop: Stopping rule satisfied. S1: Fe is feasible and has the lowest optimized canonical cost among unscreened/optimized candidates. S2: all candidates are either optimized (Fe, Ru, Os) or screened by the declared lower-reference-activity plus higher-price rule. S3: because Ru has the highest atomic activity but is not the industrial choice, BACKWARD and TEST_REACHABILITY were executed; Ru needs 201.223x activity for parity and this is unreachable on the frozen descriptor scaling manifold. S4: remaining affordable actions have low expected decision value; more extensive MC is not affordable within remaining budget.
